summary: Iter-10 book-scoped assets: validated backend (5 new tests) and frontend (AssetsPanel scoped per book). All 24 backend tests pass; FE verified that Book A and Book B's Assets panels are disjoint, including after a fresh upload to B. Drag-and-drop tile and drop zone are both present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 439 lines — still single-file; acceptable for now but approaching the recommended split threshold (>700).

duplicate_book clones asset records but does not de-dup if called repeatedly; subsequent duplicates of the duplicate will keep multiplying file rows pointing at the same storage_path. Storage stays cheap but the files collection grows. Not a bug, just an observation.

DELETE /api/books/{id} hard-deletes the book document but only soft-deletes its asset rows — slightly inconsistent persistence model (book row gone, asset rows preserved with is_deleted=true). Works for the iter-10 acceptance criteria; flag only if storage GC matters later.
Legacy assets (book_id=null) now invisible from every editor (acknowledged in agent note). Confirmed via test_upload_without_book_id_legacy.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed books/assets per run; book deletion soft-deletes their assets. Some TEST_ orphan books may remain in the library across runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_assets_book_scope_iter10.py + the existing test_assets_api.py / test_books_api.py / test_templates_api.py — 24 tests, all green. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set in env. Frontend isolation verified directly by hitting /editor/{id} and counting [data-testid="assets-grid"] tiles for two separate books.
